fields.label: Org Name
fields.help: The org to message (see the Org tab).

fields.label: To Role
fields.help: Role id to deliver to. Leave empty for the org's coordinator.

fields.label: Message
fields.help: Supports {{$json.field}} placeholders. A running org gets it now; a stopped org gets it at its next start — the output says which.

fields.label: Output Key
fields.help: Where the delivery receipt (delivery: live or queued) is stored on the output item.
